memory_candidates.content: When a plan phase's verification instructs running deploy-headless.sh (or similar) to prove artifacts are deployed, check context/patterns/regeneration-is-manual-only.md's Automated Exception subsections first -- general implementation agents are NOT a sanctioned automated caller. Instead, verify deploy currency by direct byte-diff between the source store (agent-system/extensions/**) and the deployed .claude/ tree; verify-deploy.sh's own Gate 5 (manifest-driven content-hash parity) corroborates this without needing to invoke the deploy script directly.

validate-context-budgets.sh and check-task-references.sh (and similar scripts with '../..' root resolution) must be invoked from the deployed .claude/scripts/ tree, not the agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/ source store -- they error loudly rather than silently misresolving. Always run the .claude/ copy for these verification-only scripts when both exist and are already in sync.
